Name: Uzziah, King of Judah
Summary: Uzziah, made king at sixteen, reigned fifty-two years; he sought God in the days of Zechariah, warred successfully against Philistines and Arabians, built towers and engines of war, but when strong his heart was lifted up, he burned incense in the temple, and leprosy rose in his forehead, so he lived apart as a leper until death. Also known as Azariah.
KeyStory: Azariah the priest withstood Uzziah for burning incense, and while Uzziah was wroth the leprosy rose up in his forehead before the priests.
KeyVerses: 2 Chronicles 26:1; 2 Chronicles 26:5; 2 Chronicles 26:16; 2 Chronicles 26:19; 2 Kings 15:1; 2 Kings 15:5; Isaiah 1:1; Isaiah 6:1; Isaiah 7:1; Hosea 1:1; Amos 1:1
RelatedBooks: 2 Chronicles; 2 Kings; Isaiah; Hosea; Amos; Micah
RelatedPeople: Amaziah, King of Judah; Jotham, King of Judah; Azariah, the Priest; Jecholiah, Mother of Azariah; Ahaz, King of Judah; Isaiah
LifeLesson: Strength that forgets God turns to pride, and pride into exclusion.
